name: DigiLocker
description: Digital locker to store and share verified electronic documents issued by government agencies; reduce physical paperwork.
eligibility: Indian citizens with Aadhaar (used for sign-up).
benefits: Instant access to issued documents (marksheets, licences), verified e-documents, paperless verification.
application_steps: Sign up at digilocker.gov.in with Aadhaar OTP.
Fetch issued documents from registered issuers.
Upload personal documents; share via URI/QR.
processing_time: Instant; document fetch depends on issuer.

faq.a: Yes, e-documents via DigiLocker are recognised under the IT Act as per Gazette notification.

ai_summary: DigiLocker is a free digital document wallet issuing and storing verified e-documents via Aadhaar login.
ai_explanation: DigiLocker lets citizens store and share government-issued digital documents (marksheets, driving licences, certificates) fetched directly from issuers, reducing physical paperwork. Sign-up uses Aadhaar OTP. e-Documents are legally recognised under the IT Act.

Not saving the application/reference number after submission.
